nodes.text: Harsh Gupta, Karnataka’s Principal Secretary in the Health and Family Welfare Department, said HMPV is usually detected in children under the age of 11, and about 1% of all samples tested for respiratory illnesses are HMPV positive.

nodes.author: VISAGVIJAYKUMAR
nodes.text: “This may not be the first case as monitoring was not being done earlier. However, there is no need to panic as HMPV is like any other respiratory virus, which causes common cold and flu-like symptoms during winter, especially among the younger and older age groups,” he said.
